title: Per-repo worktree.setup / worktree.teardown hooks
body:
P3.1: add worktree.setup / worktree.teardown to .openagents/ repo config, run in the background after create and before the engine starts, with OPENAGENTS_SOURCE_CHECKOUT, OPENAGENTS_WORKTREE, OPENAGENTS_WORKTREE_PORT; outside the source guard but never writing the source checkout; skipped for untrusted sources; spares stay ignored-file-free, setup runs after claim; teardown before removal/archive.

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec).
